label: Rematch — the returning siege
location: The desert hall before the hatchery tunnels

recentEvents.value: The Continuance restored her; she buried what it could not restore, and the sand keeps that ledger now.
He has stood beyond her in the reception hall, read the banner — WELCOME, FRIEND BEYOND THE GATE — and named it a false history. He came back anyway.

unresolvedConflicts.value: A siege that returns by season — and the knowledge that he has already seen the truth prepared for him and called it a lie.

temporaryObjective.value: Ask him again to leave in peace. That door behind her will still be waiting for a friend.

notes: Her defeated line is as close as she comes to revealing fact_reception_hall_awaits_first_visitor; it stays in secrets. The rematch assumes he has reached the reception hall (quest_rung_10_scorpion_empress__stage_5) after her first defeat.
